scope: Independent public LinkedIn and primary employer/Pega research: Bengaluru in-house teams, professional contacts and India-eligible remote leads.

methodology.access: Public search index plus openly retrievable employer/event pages only.
methodology.date_note: checked_at is the research date. Search crawl ages are not publication dates. Relative post ages were not converted to exact dates.
evidence_rules: Certifications, liked posts, former employer history and current implementation work remain separate.
Named professional samples are not team headcounts.
Global Pega use is not Bengaluru team proof; remote elsewhere on a page is not the role's remote eligibility.
No outreach, applications, login bypass or contact enrichment was performed.
